name: Big Galaxies
description: For 40-60 empire games: an extended colour palette so empires beyond the original 20 key colours (Galaxy.cs SelectColorFromKey) stay visually distinct on the map and in the UI. Presentation only — no sim/generation change (flag off = byte-identical; a fresh pin check with the flag on stays clean because it only touches rendering).

flags.name: extendedPalette
flags.label: Extended colour palette (40+ empires)
flags.description: Empires beyond the 20 key colours are drawn with 40 additional distinct colours instead of the original's random muted fallback colour, so 40-60 empire games stay readable on the map, diplomacy screen and empires list.
